verdict.rationale: Yubico documents official mobile SDKs for Android (YubiKit Android, USB and NFC, with high-level FIDO2 UI components) and iOS (YubiKit iOS). It also documents desktop SDKs: the .NET YubiKey SDK and python-fido2, and the latter resolves on PyPI per a runtime probe. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer corroboration of the mobile and desktop SDKs; the iOS SDK evidence is thin, covering only NFC OTP.

support.subject: As a developer, official SDKs let me integrate the key into my own desktop and mobile apps

citations.quote: Yubico has developed a range of mobile SDKs, such as for iOS and Android, and also desktop SDKs to enable developers to rapidly integrate hardware security into their apps
The SDK allows you to integrate the YubiKey and its applications into your .NET-based application or library.
YubiKit is an Android library provided by Yubico to enable YubiKey support in Android apps. Both USB and NFC-enabled YubiKeys are supported.
The library supports NFC-enabled YubiKeys and provides the APIs to request an OTP (Yubico OTP or HOTP) from the NFC YubiKeys using a NFC-enabled iOS device.
Provides library functionality for communicating with a FIDO device over USB as well as verifying attestation and assertion signatures.
